repo: main.ts renders UI via dense template-literal strings (single-quoted, minimal comments) — new code must match this style rather than refactoring toward components

tests/map.spec.ts is a Playwright suite covering the map UI, requiring updates for any new UI elements plus new unit-style coverage for scoring logic
Node's native TypeScript support (no ts-node/tsx needed) was usable to run a quick script against escalator.ts and stairs.json
workflow: Before implementing, the assistant loaded a 'brainstorming' skill as a required process step ahead of exploration and coding

friction: zsh globbing was insufficient/unreliable for extracting multiple CSS rule blocks, requiring a fallback to a script-based extraction approach
Needed multiple passes (repeated Bash extraction calls) to gather all relevant existing CSS rules (filter, thumbnail, legend, eyebrow selectors) before writing new styles
